description.narrative: The project is expected to have a high development impact in the following areas: - It will promote primary mortgage lending in Panama, expanding the market and allowing mortgage loans to previously underserved groups (lower and middle-income families); - It will improve the financial fundamentals of the Bank by allowing the bank to access long term financing, reducing maturity mismatches, and diversifying funding sources; and - It will assist in the development of the local capital markets by standardizing mortgage finance underwriting criteria for the underlying mortgage loans financed by the Facility, helping to build a securitizable pool of mortgage assets which will eventually benefit the Panamanian market.

The proposed project consists of a long-term credit facility (the Facility) for up to $40 million to fund the origination of mortgages of Banco Panameño de la Vivienda S.A. (Banvivienda or the Bank), which will meet certain eligibility criteria in the low and middle income housing market. The transaction will be structured as a Mortgage Backed Credit Line. The Facility will be secured by the underlying mortgage assets held in a bankruptcy remote Trust or suitable Special Purpose Vehicle. Banvivienda was founded in 1981 by a group of investors led by Aseguradora Mundial S.A. (Aseguradora Mundial or the Insurance Company). After a consolidation process in 2005, Grupo Mundial Tenedora S.A. (Grupo Mundial or the Group) was founded as the holding company of Banvivienda and Aseguradora Mundial. Grupo Mundial currently has a 99.77% shareholding in the bank. The Facility would help Banvivienda to: - match its mortgage portfolio origination at a time when there is growing demand for mortgage products, serving as a catalyst for Banvivienda; - address the lack of long-term funding for the low to middle income segments of the residential mortgage market in Panama; and - support the development of a standardized new asset class to be further securitized.
